title: Radiosondes: an RS41 and an M20 sharing 403.0 MHz
description: Two climbing weather balloons on one frequency, each keyed once a second in its own part of it: a Vaisala RS41-SG U2410853 (GFSK 4800 bit/s, Reed-Solomon + CRC blocks, ECEF position, 0.6 s per second) at 40 deg, 22 km out, and a Meteomodem M20 512-2-14077 (FSK 9600 Bd Manchester, frame check, 0.17 s per second) at 250 deg, 48 km out - positions on the map around the station given at generation time. Expect talkers 'RS41 U2410853' at 40 deg and 'M20 512-2-14077' at 250 deg.
